To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the emergence of high frequency neurons in a local network leads to reliable transmission and the establishment of preferential direction of signal flow.
the emergence of flexible information channel in a network is determined by the firing rate of the nodes.
the presence of high-frequency neurons in a network with random local connections, leads reliably to the transmission of signals, establishing a preferential directionality for information flow.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fundamental question of how the intrinsic properties of individual nodes determine their functional role in a network.
the fundamental question of how the brain networks can dynamically establish preferred routes for signal routing and how this can be affected by the firing rates of individual neurons.
understanding how a simple mechanism of firing rate modulation can establish effective connectivity in neuronal circuits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intrinsic firing rate is an important parameter in determining the directionality in neuronal networks.
the high firing neurons can be seen as functional hubs that are responsible for information routing in the networks.
the high-frequency neurons can be considered as a functional hub in the neuronal networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the firing rate can determine the effective connectivity in a network.
the emergence of a high frequency neuron in a network with random connections can lead to a reliable transmission of information in the network, and thus the emergence of effective connections.
in a network with homogeneous connections, the firing rate of a node is a tunable variable which can determine the effective connectivity of the node in the network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the intrinsic firing rate of a node in a network can be used as a tunable parameter for the establishment of a preferred information flow in neuronal networks.
in a complex network, a node with high firing rate can act as a functional hub.
the intrinsic activity level can determine the effective connectivity of the network and the information flow between the nodes.
